text_block_list.text: Up until now, Meisho Doto had been pursuing the ultimate ramen while honing her hospitality skills in training.

Amidst all this, an idea came up for a project:
becoming "manager for a day" and running
a pop-up shop.
choice_data_list: (If I put my training to good use, it'll surely be fi—)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I'm so anxioussss!!!!
choice_data_list: What was all that training for!?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, while I certainly learned some important things...
Still... knowing just how incredible the pros are
makes me lose confidence—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: "To think that after the fans came with such high expectations, I might show them a pathetic performance—"
choice_data_list: As long as you give it your honest best in your own way, that's more than enough.
As long as you give it your honest, sincere best in your own way, that's more than enough.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: ...True to myself...

"Yes. The utmost hospitality and flavor for everyone
who visits the shop, including our fans.
In short, what truly matters is—"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: ...My sincere heart.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... You're right.
I-I'll give it everything I've got!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: W-W-Welcomeeee!!
choice_data_list: Party of two, right this way!

text_block_list.name: Fan
text_block_list.text:
Um... well then, here's Doto's special ram—
Huh? "Rameme"?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Gah!? I-I'm so sorry!
I made a mistake writing the menu!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ugh... I messed up again...!*sniff*

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
"Hahaha, don't worry about it!
Stay calm and do your best, Doto-chan!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ngh......
Th-Thank you so much......!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for waitiiing!
Here is the Doto Special Ramen, extra large,
and the gyoza combo set meal!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa, this is so good!"
"This is way too high quality for a fan event!
They put serious effort into this!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh... Thank goodness...!
It looks like everyone's really enjoying it...!

text_block_list.name: Athletic Store Managers
text_block_list.text:
—Yo. Look who's finally become
the master of their own castle, Doto!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Huh... What!?
Who are you people...!?

text_block_list.name: Intimidating Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
"...Let's see it then.
How you intend to... entertain us."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeeeek!?
It's all the shopkeepers who took care of me during my training...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh... T-To think the store manager and everyone
would actually come...! How should I entertain them...?
choice_data_list: No different from any other customer.
You're treated just like any other customer, you know.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh...?
choice_data_list: Even if she's my former master, she came here as a customer.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
...!
Yes. That's exactly right!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
So that everyone can go home happy
...I'll give it everything I've got!!

text_block_list.name: Intimidating Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text: Hmm... An ice-cold wet towel, huh...

text_block_list.name: Apprenticeship Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
"Plus, a big glass of cold water.
I can see the care put in to make sure patrons
can enjoy hot ramen even in the late-summer heat..."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Here you go!
It'sh Doto's special ramen!

text_block_list.name: Intimidating Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
Mmm...! A classic shoyu ramen nailed to perfection,
with chashu and back fat packing a seriously hearty punch...

text_block_list.name: Athletic Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
The taste is a bit on the salty side... yet somehow,
that just makes it taste even damn better!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-It's hot today, and I figured everyone
would be sweating, so...!
I made it with a slightly spicy flavor!

text_block_list.name: Intimidating Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text: ...Both the hospitality and the flavor are perfectly tailored to the guest... Magnificent...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Y-You're exaggerating, really.
I was just...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
...I just thought about what kind of hospitality would make them happy,
what would touch their hearts, and did it.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"If you received it as a welcome service,
then I'm…… truly deeply moved!"

text_block_list.name: Athletic Store Manager
text_block_list.text: ...I see. So gettin' three whole naruto slices is part of the service, too.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: "H-Huh!? T-That was just an accident, I slipped it in by mistakkke!!"

text_block_list.name: Athletic Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
"Gwahahaha!! That's the spirit!
Being true to yourself is part of your charm!"

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
""Yeah! She's clumsy, but gives it her all!"
"And that's what makes Doto-chan so great!""

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: E-Everyone...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm clumsy and unrefined,
but I'll continue to do my very besht!
